Bug_Title: "Math.abs" and negation should not be used on numbers that could be "MIN_VALUE"
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that the Math.abs() function is used on an integer value that could be Integer.MIN_VALUE. If the value is Integer.MIN_VALUE, then the result of Math.abs() will be incorrect due to integer overflow.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggered the bug by calling the showBug method with Integer.MIN_VALUE as the argument. This caused Math.abs to be used on a number that could be MIN_VALUE, leading to incorrect results.
